scope: Only f83r.1-f83r.8 and f83r.9-f83r.17 from the existing GDT928 packet; ZL3b and IT2a streams. RF1b has no complete paragraph flags.

variables.M: one treatment or medicine kind; not a physical dose or portion
variables.S: persistent affected sensory state; motor function is a separate unknown slot
variables.H: reported preceding history and cause-localization evidence
variables.R: reported response/outcome; not automatically causal proof

reference_grammar: CASE_FRAME introduces C; recurrence of tchedy does not itself prove a new patient.
INTRODUCE(C,M,S) binds M as a treatment kind and S as an affected state; same spelling does not prove same physical dose.
REPORT(C,H,S) keeps a reported history distinct from an authorially true diagnosis.
APPLY(M,D) and APPLY(M,P) preserve treatment-kind identity while changing site; the equality M_D = M_P is an explicit working assumption, not a consequence of repeated spelling.
NO_BENEFIT(M,D,S) licenses the changed-site proposal but does not prove that another medicine at D would fail.
RESPONSE(C,R) records an outcome; R does not by itself establish BECAUSE(P,R).
NEGATE_OR_EXCLUDE scopes over the nearest predeclared proposition unless the line-level reading marks a wider scope.
REPRISE(P1,P2) is a cross-paragraph hypothesis that unifies C, M, D, P, S and H; the independent-case rival leaves these variables distinct.
Every non-core whole form is one persistent unknown lexical variable wherever repeated; unknown groups are role-constrained, never filler or deleted.
semantic_assumptions: P1 and P2 are two presentations of one case under REPRISE; this is a hypothesis, not an observed identity.
M is a treatment kind, not a conserved physical portion; P1/P2 do not establish dose identity.
D and P are distinct application sites; the causal relation from H to P is a working content assumption.
The reported response R does not entail that P caused recovery; a causal reading is a separate rival.
Aligned ZL3b/IT2a variant forms are retained as stream variants; no unrecorded normalization or EVA morphology supplies a meaning.
The old 376 fallback vocabulary, 993 Goat/Wolf/Cabbage values and renderer roles are not inherited.

binary_alternatives.different_consequence: The rival predicts a medication substitution without requiring a site change; it leaves the H-to-P localization edge unused.

binary_alternatives.rival: P1 and P2 are independent cases
binary_alternatives.different_consequence: The rival allows homonymous roles to refer to different patients, medicines and sites, so no cross-paragraph content transfer is predicted.

stop_condition: If the 223 non-core occurrences cannot be assigned finite argument roles without assigning 92 singleton meanings or changing repeated values, retain the exact unknown groups and report the conflict; do not repair with filler, old glosses, EVA similarity or a new production.
